gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ that they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = not tell anyone.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: shouldn't have + participle criticises a past action.

gaps.lead: We expect to announce the winner tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: We expect to announce X → X is expected to be announced.

gaps.lead: The committee is unlikely to change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ that the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal it: It is unlikely that…

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ seen his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + had + participle: whether we had seen.
